source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
As long as the only units **engaged** with an enemy unit are **FORTIFICATION** units:

- It can be picked as a target for ranged attacks.
- Ranged attacks against it take −1 to their **[Hit rolls](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls)**, except **[[CLOSE-QUARTERS]](vsdata:weapon-ability/close-quarters)** attacks.
- When it is picked for a **[fall-back move](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back)** while not **battle-shocked**, its **[hazard rolls](vsdata:core-rule/hazard-rolls)** pass automatically.

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 7 of 300 sampled combat readings of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.

effects.appliesTo: ranged attacks targeting that enemy unit

effects.trigger: that enemy unit is picked to Fall Back
